newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-TOPPING CALLED UP TO FACE ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TOPPING CALLED UP TO FACE ENGLAND.

text.p: Wing James Topping was named on Sunday in the Ireland side to face England in their Five Nations match at Lansdowne Road on Saturday.
In the only change to the side whobeat Wales 26-25 in Cardiff, Topping, who missed that match because of influenza takes over on the left wing from Dominic Crotty.
Ireland still have injury doubts over flanker David Corkery and centre Johnathan Bell and if they fail to recover by Thursday then Anthony Foley and Kurt McQuilkin will step in.

Ireland - Jim Staples (captain); Dennis Hickie, Jonathan Bell, Maurice Field, James Topping; Eric Elwood, Niall Hogan; Eric Miller, Denis McBride, David Corkery, Jeremy Davidson, Paddy Johns, Paul Wallace, Ross Nesdale, Nick Popplewell.
